reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn band_clamp(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=3{return None}let l=nums(p[0])?;let h=nums(p[1])?;let a=nums(p[2])?;if l.len()!=1||h.len()!=1||l[0]>h[0]{return None}let(lo,hi)=(l[0],h[0]);Some(a.into_iter().map(|x|x.clamp(lo,hi).to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
